title: Anonymous Report From Cantonese Presidents 10316

page_data.en:
Rough translation of anonymous report from Cantonese residents to
The Council: 10/3/16.
（印：HEADQUARTERS CENTRAL REGISTRY. No. 2354 24.3.1917）

The writers, Cantonese residents, state that they have carried
on business peacefully in the Settlement and among the bad characters
dealt with, whether there were any Cantonese, the Police knew and
could tell. However a curious person, Yang Cheng, was born in
Kwangtung; he was a student in Austria & then in Germany where
his general reputation was very bad and after dismissal or recalled
to Peking he was proceeded against for adultery etc. He has been
in the habit of creating rumours, having employed a number of
loafers for the purpose of extortion or doing injury to others, as
well as acting as German spy. Since re-appointment as Special
Envoy for Foreign Affairs he has been more daring and has appointed
Li Meng, Tao Yih Ming & brothers Ling Shih Tsong
private detectives named Ma Feng-ze & others for the purpose of
& making false accusations against ^
deceiving the Cantonese who are not going to remain reticent.
Moreover, according to Settlement Regulations, why or private
detectives of the Chinese official could not do anything to
injurious to law-abiding native residents. A man Tang who resides
the other day
in the French Settlement and he was arrested in Chapel but when
he was taken through the Settlements the Foreign Police appeared as
"blind and this is ridiculous. Yang Cheng's detective Tap Teh-ming
is among them(?) being instigated by Yang Cheng - they create
rumours for the purpose of doing meritorious service for rewards.
They bribe the newspaper to make an explanation of the case etc.
The Municipal Councils of the two Settlements are requested to take
steps for the maintenance of peace & good order. They are informed
the British Consul General has not been correctly informed and
very
requested to assist him and so Yang Cheng has been daring to do things
PREPARED in such a manner. The Council is requested to take action with
CAPTAIN SUPT. OF POLICE.
a view to protection of the Municipality's good name &c.
（签名）

page_data.zh:
致工部局：广东籍居民匿名报告的粗略译文：1916年3月10日。
（印章：总部中央登记处。编号 2354 1917年3月24日）

撰文者系广东籍居民，称其在租界内一直和平经商，至于所处置的不法分子中是否有广东人，警方知情且能够说明。然而，有一个名叫杨成（音译）的可疑人物，出生于广东；他曾在奥地利求学，后又在德国学习，其总体声誉极差，在被解职或召回北京后，曾因通奸等罪名被起诉。他惯于制造谣言，雇佣了一批游手好闲之徒，旨在敲诈勒索或伤害他人，并充当德国间谍。自从重新被任命为外交特派员以来，他更加大胆，任命了李孟（音译）、陶一鸣（音译）及凌世宗（音译）兄弟，以及名为马凤泽（音译）等人的私人侦探，目的是欺骗并不打算保持沉默的广东人，并对他们提出虚假指控。此外，根据租界章程，中国官员的私人侦探为何不能对守法的本国居民做出任何有害之举？一名姓唐的男子日前居住在法租界，他在小教堂（Chapel）被捕，但当其被押送穿过租界时，外国警察却视若无睹，这实在荒谬。杨成的侦探塔德明（Tap Teh-ming，音译）也在其中（？），受杨成指使——他们制造谣言，旨在立功请赏。他们贿赂报纸，以对案件等进行解释。现请求两租界的工部局采取措施，以维护和平与良好秩序。特此告知，英国总领事未获得准确信息，恳请协助他，因此杨成才敢如此行事。现请求工部局采取行动，并与警务处处长商议，以期保护市政当局的良好声誉等。
（签名）
代理
